topic.readerProblem: Choose a Trakkr tier using brand, prompt, model, seat, and evidence requirements rather than headline volume.
topic.connection: Helps AEOeye readers budget recurring AI answer monitoring after identifying a visibility gap.

assessment: The final Trakkr Pricing (2026): Brands, Prompts, Models, and Annual Cost guide answers a direct AEO-software buying question with official documentation, reproducible arithmetic, explicit documentation-only limits, and a concrete fit decision. It does not claim product use or outcome testing.

The main editor independently recomputed every worked example from cited inputs and kept checkout, quote, tax, or unknown-field caveats adjacent to the arithmetic.
The main editor read the complete final draft, including opening, tables, images and alt text, internal links, limitations, conclusion, and all four FAQs.
